cohort: 17,997 participants (3579 Syrian refugees and 14,418 Turkish women) who delivered in the Labor Department of a hospital in Turkey between January 2016 and December 2020
finding: Syrian refugees experienced a higher incidence of adverse perinatal outcomes, including lower birth weight, increased risk of low birth weight, and a higher rate of stillbirths, compared to Turkish women.
mod_finding: Syrian refugees had a lower rate of primary cesarean deliveries compared to Turkish women.
